summary: Loads model geometry exposed by the installed OpenVR driver, such as controller, headset, or peripheral meshes.
common_gotchas: Do not treat OpenVR SOP as a stable asset library; the driver controls which model names exist.
This SOP outputs geometry only and does not replace OpenVR CHOP/TOP tracking or rendering workflows.
Because it is Windows-only, keep a non-VR mesh fallback for portable networks.
key_concepts: OpenVR SOP outputs meshes supplied by the active OpenVR driver.
The available models are driver-provided and can change between devices or driver versions.
The official page marks the operator as Microsoft Windows only.
